title: Kinhold Animated Trailer
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext:
Welcome to Kinhold! Kinhold is a third-person survival and settlement-building game set in a world where nothing is decoration. Every stone, tree, and inch of soil is a real resource sitting in a real place, and once it is taken it stays gone. You play the one character here who does not age, guiding villagers who very much do: raise them and build a settlement that is still standing long after they are not. When the raids start, arm them, fight your enemies and conquer their settlements. Play it solo, or bring a friend along in co-op.

This trailer has been made Claude Code and Jazz Hands (a custom video editing software made by Claude Code)!
